Title: @better-auth/drizzle-adapter: Concurrent requests can exceed rate limits on PostgreSQL
Description: Database-backed rate limiting on PostgreSQL can let a burst of concurrent requests go over the configured maximum. When many requests arrive at the same time, several of them can pass the limit check together. This weakens the rate limit on password sign-in, two-factor verification, one-time codes, password resets, and other rate-limited endpoints.
NotImpacted: All versions before 1.6.17, all versions starting from 1.7.7
